title: Two-generator graph operad has assembly presentation
author: Aval, Jean-Christophe; Samuele, Giraudo; Karaboghossian, Théo; Tanasa, Adrian
work: Operads on graphs: extending the pre-Lie operad and general construction

primary_locator.required_new_core: exact graph operad composition/species/free-operad and ComMag embedding setup; two generating relations, commutative assembly normal-form reduction, partition-separated graph supports and injective tensor product evaluation

difficulty_reason: The proof gives a normal-form reduction to commutative assemblies of commutative-magmatic trees, then proves the graph evaluation is injective on that generating family. Proposition 2.11 establishes the complete relations and absence of additional relations by a graph-support argument, a nonroutine presentation task.
